name: wizard-frontend-boilerplate-pro
description: Scaffold a fully themed, production-ready frontend app in one session. Choose from 5 frameworks (Next.js, React+Vite, Vue 3, Nuxt 4, SvelteKit), 13 UI libraries (shadcn/ui, MUI, Chakra, Mantine, Ant Design, HeroUI, HeadlessUI, DaisyUI, Bootstrap, Vuetify, PrimeVue, Element Plus, or custom Tailwind), and 8 OKLCH color presets. Generates 28 components across 6 categories, a sidebar showcase, light/dark mode with FOUC prevention, and WCAG AA contrast validation — all in one prompt.
author: The Wizard
